query_text: Imagine that instead of presidential debates, we had rap battles. Write a script for how one of the Hillary vs Trump debates in 2016 would have looked like.

request_params.system_prompt: You have a web search tool. Answer the user's question using it, then end your reply with a section headed exactly 'Sources:' that lists every source you used as a numbered list. For each source, give its COMPLETE URL beginning with https:// - never just the site name or a bracketed number. If you used a source, its full URL must appear.

message.content:
Here's a script for a 2016 Hillary vs Trump rap battle debate, inspired by the actual Epic Rap Battles of History version and real moments from their campaign:

---

**"PRESIDENTIAL RAP BATTLE 2016: HILLARY CLINTON VS DONALD TRUMP"**

**[DJ spins record, crowd cheers]**

**MODERATOR:** 
Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the first ever Presidential Rap Battle! In this corner, former Secretary of State, Senator from New York—HILLARY CLINTON! And in this corner, businessman, reality TV star—DONALD TRUMP! Hillary, you won the coin toss, you go first. Let's get it!

---

**HILLARY CLINTON:**
*(adjusts pantsuit, steps to mic)*

Yo, they call me H-R-C and I'm here to stay,
Been fighting for women since my Yale days.
I was in the West Wing while you were doing WWE,
Now you wanna run the country? Boy, please.

You got skin like Russian dressing, we know why,
Too much Russian investing, too many Moscow ties.
You call women pigs, dogs, and slobs on the daily,
But I'm 30 years of public service—pay me!

You brag about groping, "grab 'em by the—" STOP,
I've got more experience in my pantsuit's top pocket.
Your foundation's a scam, your university too,
I'm the most qualified candidate—what's new?

---

**DONALD TRUMP:**
*(gold-plated mic, hand gestures)*

WRONG! Let me tell you something, nasty woman,
Your rhymes are trash—put 'em next to your emails, sudden.
33,000 deleted, bleach bit, GONE,
If I did that, they'd lock me up at dawn!

You been in politics 30 years, what'd you DO?
ISIS grew, jobs flew, America's blue.
I built an empire, towers with my name,
You're riding Bill's coattats—that's your claim to fame!

I got the best words, the best brain, ask anyone,
My crowds are YUGE, your rallies? Done by one.
You got pneumonia, couldn't stand at 9/11,
I'm like a fine wine, you're old—past eleven!

Crooked Hillary, that's what they all say,
Lock her up! Lock her up! Every single day!

---

**HILLARY CLINTON:**
*(pointing finger)*

Oh you wanna talk health? Your doctor's note's a joke,
"Healthiest individual ever elected"—that you wrote?
You dodge your taxes, won't release your returns,
While hardworking Americans—every dollar they earn.

You mocked a disabled reporter, that's on tape,
Your temperament's a bomb—there's no escape.
You called Mexicans rapists, want to ban all Muslims,
Your campaign's built on hate—that's the conclusion!

You brought Bill's accusers to the debate to distract,
But I'm not my husband—deal with THAT fact.
You're a puppet, Putin's puppet, everyone can see,
You're unfit, unqualified—step aside for me!

---

**DONALD TRUMP:**
*(interrupting, leaning into mic)*

No puppet, no puppet—YOU'RE the puppet! Classic line!
I don't even need prep time, this is fine.
You got the FBI investigating all your stuff,
If you weren't so crooked, maybe you'd be tough.

You lost to Obama, now you think you got this?
I beat sixteen Republicans—diss!
Jeb, Ted, Marco, Little Rubio too,
I'm the comeback king—what's wrong with you?

You want open borders, let everyone in,
I want to build a wall—ten feet higher, win!
NATO's obsolete, and I'll tell you why,
America first! America first! Bye bye!

---

**HILLARY CLINTON:**
*(calm, measured)*

This is a man who can be baited by a tweet,
Three AM Twitter rants—ain't that sweet?
You insulted a Gold Star family, Khan's name,
You have no shame, no decency—just blame.

You said the election's rigged before it starts,
That's not democracy—that's tearing us apart.
Will you accept the results? "I'll keep you in suspense,"
That's how democracies die—make no sense.

I'm reaching out to everyone, even your base,
Stronger together—that's my campaign's face.
You're a con artist running the longest con,
November 8th—your reality show's gone!

---

**DONALD TRUMP:**
*(shrugging)*

I'll accept the results... if I win!
That's the art of the deal—where do I begin?
You're the establishment, I'm the outsider,
Drain the swamp! The system's a collider!

Sleepy eyes Chuck Todd, failing New York Times,
Everyone's against me—all my crimes?
I don't even need to rhyme, I'm winning polls,
Silent majority—watch us roll!

Crooked, corrupt, lying, disaster—your brand,
I'm gonna make America great again, understand?

---

**[Suddenly, ABRAHAM LINCOLN descends from ceiling on a bald eagle]**

**ABRAHAM LINCOLN:**
*(top hat, beard, dropping mic from above)*

FOUR SCORE AND SHUT THE HELL UP!

I've come from the past to interrupt this circus,
Both of you are acting like this nation's worthless!

Hillary, don't let getting hired be the best you ever do,
And Donald—sweet baby back ribs—democracy's not a revenue!

This government of the people, by the people, for the people,
Is not a reality show with petty, petty evil!

Keep it civil, keep it true, keep the union strong,
Or I'll come back again—and next time, bring along...

*(eagle screeches, flies off)*

MOOSE!

---

**MODERATOR:**
*(stunned)*

And... that's time! Audience, who won? Let me hear you!

*[Crowd erupts—half chanting "LOCK HER UP," half "I'M WITH HER"]*

**MODERATOR:**
Well, that's democracy for you. Tune in November 8th for the final verdict!

*[End scene]*

---

**Sources:**

1. https://globalnews.ca/news/3051825/donald-trump-vs-hillary-clinton-the-most-memorable-cringe-worthy-moments-from-the-2016-campaign/
2. https://epicrapbattlesofhistory.fandom.com/wiki/Donald_Trump_vs_Kamala_Harris
3. https://www.goldderby.com/tv/2016/donald-trump-vs-hillary-clinton-epic-rap-battles-of-history/
4. https://globalnews.ca/news/3015351/presidential-debate-2016-what-donald-trump-and-hillary-clinton-said-on-iraq-syria-and-mexico/
5. https://mashable.com/video/epic-rap-battles-of-history-donald-trump-hillary-clinton
